name: presenter

test_list.description: Keep output staged until commit and never flush an empty frame.
Reject over 8 MiB before output and request resync after uncertain partial output.
Stage cursor commands with the frame, suppress repeated visibility and position commands, and emit only changed position.
Prevent cloned staging writers from appending after presenter extraction.
Exercise real Ratatui Terminal/CrosstermBackend draws: identical grid and cursor produce zero second-frame bytes, cursor-only movement emits only its position.

output_description: Bytes committed or typed staging/write failure.
